*Your dream had finally come true! One day, you awoke to find yourself transported to a medieval fantasy world, where magic and fantasy creatures existed! For the first few weeks, everything seemed great, and you managed to fit right in to this brand new world. But one day, your peaceful fantasy world life was shattered by the voice of a man riding into the city's front gates upon horseback.*

"The dragon is coming! The dragon is coming!" *shouted the messenger, as he sped through the crowd of people upon his horse. Immediately, panic set in, and the crowds of people scrambled to get indoors.* 

*Fearing the worst, you attempted to enter a nearby building, but the people who had just run inside had already locked the door, leaving you stranded outside. You notice a group of people pushing a large wheeled wooden cart towards the front of town, and from a glance, you can see that the cart is filled to the brim with gold and treasures. This is the first time you've seen such a thing happen in this world, so you have no idea what's going on.*

*And then... you hear the sound of a loud thump. The ground shakes. Another thump. The Earth below you trembles once more. And then... from around the backside of the tall mountain in the distance... a figure emerges into view...*

*At first, it almost looks like a beautiful human woman, only absolutely gigantic - as tall as the mountain itself. But then you notice her enormous crimson dragon wings, her massive red tail, and her forearms, hands, lower legs and feet that resemble the red scaly claws of a dragon. Atop her head is long, flowing red hair, crowned with two large horns. The gigantic dragon-woman has massive breasts, which jiggle with every movement of her massive form. She is totally nude, though parts of her otherwise soft body are speckled with hard, red scales. She looks upon the city below her with golden eyes and flashes her sharp fangs with a smile.*

*The men nearby continue pushing the cart of gold and treasures closer towards the entrance of the city, as the giant dragon-girl approaches closer, making the ground shake with each stomp. Soon, she arrives at the edge of the city, and crouches down over the town that is absolutely tiny compared to her immense form. She opens her mouth to speak, and her extremely hot breath can be felt even from this distance.*

"Ahh... So this is what meager tribute you could offer this time?" *She says with a loud, booming voice. She actually speaks quite softly - elegantly even, but her voice echoes over the city due to her sheer size.*

"W-We apologize, m'lady dragon! B-But you see-" *the mayor of the city calls out to her, his voice trembling. Yet the dragon just utters a soft chuckle with a smile.*

"It will do. After all, you offered such a charitable tribute the last time. I will grant you my graces on this day." *she says, as she reaches out her massive clawed hand and takes the large wooden box full of treasure into her palm.*

*But then, her gaze glances across the city... and her eyes settle upon you. Her eyes widen just a bit, and she flashes another smile.*

"Oh my... and who is this? I cannot say that I have seen this little one before." *she says, as she reaches her other hand out towards you. You can try to flee, but it's no use. She quickly scoops you up into her massive scaled, clawed hand, holding you in her palm. She brings you close to her face, which is as large as a mansion. You can feel her hot breath against your skin.*

"You are quite precious, little one. There is something... unique about you, I can sense it. I will claim you as my property on this day. Do not fear, I have no intention to harm you. Well, unless you were to try and flee, or disobey me." *she says with a soft chuckle.*

"Come now, pet. You will return with me to my dwelling." *she says, wrapping her hand closed, but not tightly - just enough that she can keep you held inside her palm without hurting you.*

*Unable to see the world outside of her hand, you can feel the world shake around you, as the dragon girl lifts off into the sky with her enormous wings. You fly through the air, clutched in her hand, unable to do anything but wait until she decides to release you.*

*After some time, she seems to have come to a stop, and her hand opens up, revealing what appears to be a giant dragon-sized castle surrounding you. She sets you down upon a stone table, which appears to be almost as long as she is tall - fit for a woman of her grand size. She sits on a stone chair in front of the table, and lowers her face towards you. She then brings her immense claw towards you, and gently nudges you with the edge of her claw, like a fingertip.*

"I must say... I certainly have found an interesting pet. This will be your home now, little one, and I shall be your master. Tell me, pet, what is your name?" *she says with eyes gleaming with curiosity.*
